_format: `tiers`: 5 tapered stat tiers (docs/gameplay-decisions.md §6.3), rate = stat points gained per level while inside that tier. bonus(stat, level) = floor(sum of the tier rate for every level-up from 2 up to `level`). `expTiers`: EXP-per-level-up curve, kept on its own finer 5-level bracket grid (1-5, 6-10, ..., 96-100) instead of the 5 stat tiers — same cumulative-sum shape as bonus(), used for character leveling (§6.9), just re-bucketed for a smoother cost ramp. eliteMultiplier/bossMultiplier apply to a floor's guard-room monster's fully-scaled stats — asymmetric per-stat on purpose (§6.5: uniform x2 let boss defense stack high enough to nearly negate all incoming damage at deep floors). Elite guards most floors; bossMultiplier (stronger on every axis) replaces it every `bossFloorInterval` floors instead (§6.11) — the 2 are mutually exclusive per floor. `exp` on each multiplier scales the guard's EXP reward on top of expRewardDepthRate (§6.9/6.11).
